failures.cause: Suspected cause: a second region of the same label over a flaw that another region already matched. One truth event produced two regions; the matcher is one-to-one, so it takes the closer one and counts this one as a false alarm. The region fragmented instead of merging - regions separated by less than 0.2 s are joined, and this pair is further apart than that.
